name: Gratis Starter Kit: Source, Prompts & Setup Guide
description_md:
# What You Get

The Gratis source, the prompts from the video, and a practical setup guide you can hand to Claude Code or Codex.

- 
Public source: A downloadable snapshot of the MIT-licensed Gratis core, plus the GitHub link for updates. No community membership required to use the source.

- 
Setup help: Copy-paste installation prompt, prerequisites, provider sign-in, first-response checks and troubleshooting.

- 
Video prompts: The recorded app request with local details removed, a camera feasibility template and the historical photo question. Revised templates are labeled separately.

- 
Experiment notes: The tools used in the recorded DeepSeek experiment, what was actually verified, and how that build differs from the reviewed public app.

- 
Verification checklist: Check that a real reply and saved conversation work before relying on an automation.

Start with START-HERE.html or START-HERE.md inside the kit. For live replies, bring your own eligible provider account. Model subscriptions, API credits and hosting are not included.

The public-core snapshot documents Apple silicon macOS as its packaged target. It is source code, not a signed installer. Current community features and other-platform packages are separate. Photo identification and camera firmware modification are not supplied or claimed as completed.

Free to download. Optional contributions are welcome; choose $0 to get the complete kit. Experimental software with no warranty or maintenance commitment. Independent of GrokBot and the model providers; review licenses and permissions before use.
